hero.title: Your business deserves to be
hero.subtitle: Cosmic Studio builds websites and apps for craftspeople, associations and independents. We make sure people find you on Google, and we are still there once your site is live.

audience.title: For people who already have a trade and no time to learn another.

artisans.title: Craftspeople
artisans.description: Carpenter, plumber, hairdresser, caterer… A site that says what you do, where you work and how to reach you, and that people find when they search for your trade nearby.

associations.title: Associations
associations.description: Choir, sports club, collective… Your events, memberships and news in one place, to make your activities known and welcome new members.

independents.title: Independents starting out
independents.description: Therapist, consultant, photographer… A professional site from the start, at a price that keeps pace with your business.

why.title: Wix and WordPress are handy at first.
why.lead: Then you need a paid plugin, an update breaks a page, the subscription goes up. We write the code ourselves, so your site stays fast and can grow without starting over.

ownership.title: You own it
ownership.description: Your texts, your photos and your domain name belong to you from day one. The code is transferred to you after {months} months of subscription, or earlier for a transfer fee.

fast.title: Fast, and well placed on Google
fast.description: Without a heavy theme or plugins, your pages load quickly on a phone, and Google takes that into account in its results.

person.title: Someone who answers
person.description: You talk to Matthieu, who knows your site because he built it.

grows.title: A site that keeps pace with you
grows.description: A page today, a shop or an app later, without rebuilding everything.

process.title: Four steps, no surprises.
process.subtitle: From the first conversation to launch day, you know where your project stands.

discovery.label: T-3 · Meeting
discovery.title: We get to know each other
discovery.description: Twenty minutes on the phone or over a coffee in Geneva or Annecy, to talk about your trade, your customers and what the site should do for you.

design.label: T-2 · Mockup
design.title: You see it before you decide
design.description: We prepare a mockup of your home page with your colours and your texts. It is free and commits you to nothing.

build.label: T-1 · Build
build.title: We build the site
build.description: Allow two to six weeks depending on the project. You follow progress on a private link and send us your feedback along the way.

launch.label: T-0 · Launch
launch.title: We stay after launch
launch.description: We put the site online and show you how it works. After that, we take care of hosting, backups and small changes.

apps.title: We also build our own apps.
apps.lead: We use them to try out tools before using them for clients, and what we learn then goes into your projects.

daily_fortune.name: Daily Fortune
daily_fortune.description: A short message every morning to start the day on the right foot. It is our first app, available on the App Store and Google Play.

studio.title: Behind Cosmic Studio, there is Matthieu.
paragraphs: I'm Matthieu Compérat. I come from Duingt, on the shores of Lake Annecy, and I now live in Chêne-Bougeries. I have been building websites and apps for about fifteen years, first for large companies. With Cosmic Studio, I work directly with craftspeople, associations and independents.
When you call, I'm the one who picks up, and your messages get a reply the same day. I know the site I deliver inside out, which keeps every change quick and simple.

cta.description: Tell us about your business in a few lines. We reply quickly to talk it through, before suggesting anything.
cta.freeMockup: Still unsure? Start with a <link>free mockup</link>.
cta.title: Let's make your business shine.
